recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It is a narrow source correction completing an already-approved and mostly-applied issue; no further work-group review is needed unless maintainers choose to regenerate or retire the stale unreferenced SVG separately.
issue_request: FHIR-36081 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested removal of Subscription.notificationUrlLocation, payload-specific SHALL/SHALL NOT guidance for SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent.focus, and, in the Jira comment, removal of the now-unneeded SubscriptionStatus.eventsInNotification.
initial_application: Git commit c1d340d7c8 applied the main issue by deleting Subscription.notificationUrlLocation and URL-location terminology, removing SubscriptionStatus.eventsInNotification from the StructureDefinition and notes, updating Subscription notification payload guidance, and adding an event-notification invariant. A later source check found one missed commented-out eventsInNotification line in a $status response example.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Subscription and SubscriptionStatus as active resources. source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-status.xml includes $status-response.txt, which includes source/subscription/subscription-status-response.xml, so the stale example comment was in current build scope. Current StructureDefinitions and narrative guidance otherwise reflect the issue. A raw SVG file still contains a historical eventsInNotification string, but it is an unreferenced SVG/diagram artifact and was not edited as authoritative source.
reconciliation: Removed the commented-out <eventsInNotification value="0"/> line from source/subscription/subscription-status-response.xml. After the edit, no non-SVG source references to notificationUrlLocation or eventsInNotification remained.
source_changes: source/subscription/subscription-status-response.xml: removed the commented-out <eventsInNotification value="0"/> line from the $status response example.
